verdict.line: You lose if you extend past your minions once Camille hits level 6 with R up; you win by forcing every trade to happen inside your own Hallowed Mist.

brief.thesis: Camille's entire kill pattern — auto-attack shield stacking, the empowered Q auto, and the targeted dash on R (Hextech Ultimatum) — requires her to directly hit or target you, and W (Hallowed Mist) states you 'can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.' That single interaction is why the measured numbers sit near even (50.5% over 537 games) with lane and solo-kill advantage still on Gwen's side, despite Camille's reputation as a lane bully.

theirWindow.when: Level 6-8, you're pushed past minion wave
theirWindow.what: Once Camille hits 6, R (Hextech Ultimatum) directly targets and anchors you regardless of mist, and if she's near a wall she can chain E (Hookshot)'s knockup into the combo. Hold near minion cover through this window instead of shoving deep.

yourWindow.what: Without E up she has no gap-close or wall-jump escape for 16 to 12 seconds depending on rank. Drop W, walk up, and trade freely with Q — she cannot punish the extension.

R-E all-in threat if you're caught extended

start.item: Doran's Ring, Health Potion, Health Potion
start.why: Run in 50.6% of 559 tracked games (91% pick rate); the extra potion covers you through Camille's early Q-auto trades while you wait for E at 3.

boots.why: Picked in 40.8% of games at 52.6% win rate; every point of Camille's kit — autos, Q, W's cone, R's bonus auto damage — is physical, so flat DR blunts her whole trade pattern.

core.why: First item in the highest-performing path (56.8% win rate, 81 games) and gives the burst needed to punish her when E lands.
Second item in that same build path; adds execute-style burst that pairs with your passive's health-percent scaling.
Closes out the 56.8%-winrate path; by this point R's cooldown is near 8.5s, so raw AP compounds every cast.

situational.when: she lands the E-into-R all-in combo and you need to survive the burst window
the game goes long and you need sustain to out-trade her in extended skirmishes

runes.keystoneWhy: Run in the top page (50.9% win rate, 33.4% pick); stacks through your E-empowered autos and R hits during the extended trades Hallowed Mist lets you initiate safely.

summoners.why: Highest win rate and pick rate combo (53.1% over 63.3% of games); with solo-kill advantage already on your side, Ignite turns your mist-forced trades into kills instead of pushes.

playing.title: Hug the mist
playing.detail: Drop W (Hallowed Mist) before trading so Camille's autos, empowered Q, and R's targeted dash can't touch you unless she physically walks in. This forces every fight onto your terms.

playing.title: Bait E onto open ground
playing.detail: E (Hookshot) needs a wall to land its knockup; if you keep the wave away from walls she has no engage or escape for 16-12 seconds depending on rank.

playing.title: Snip through her, not just minions
playing.detail: Q (Snip Snip!) deals true damage to whatever's centered in the cone and applies passive on every snip, so angle it to clip Camille directly during trades.

playing.title: Dash out after E's steroid
playing.detail: E (Skip 'n Slash) grants attack speed, range, and magic on-hit for a few seconds; land an auto in that window to refund the cooldown, then retreat back into mist.

playing.title: Respect walls once she's 6-8
playing.detail: Her R (Hextech Ultimatum) can target and anchor you directly, and near a wall she can chain E's knockup into it. Stay on minion cover through this stretch.

playing.title: Hold R early, don't force it
playing.detail: Needlework sits at 120-80 seconds cooldown for its first two ranks, so use it to poke and proc passive rather than committing before your E is up to follow in.

playing.title: Spam R once it hits rank 3
playing.detail: At 8.5-8 seconds cooldown, Needlework becomes a near-constant poke and heal tool in extended fights, a reset pattern Camille has no equivalent for.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, boots, runes, and summoner picks are pulled directly from OP.GG matches on the current patch (16.18.1) at the sample sizes listed; the mist-positioning and wall-dependent engage reasoning behind them is my own tactical read, not measured data.
